november is all souls day: envelopes are available at church exits for lists of your deceased . twelve masses will be celebrated during the month of november for your deceased. our annual mass for those who died during the past year will take place in st. michael's church on friday 13th november at 7 pm church of ireland 225th service of thanksgiving will take place in the church of ireland, foxford on 1st november at 4.30 pm . bishop michael burrows will preach and everyone is welcome. invitation to get involved: at the recent meeting of the parish pastoral council, the desire for greater lay participation in our weekend parish masses was discussed . we would love to see more families and parishioners getting involved. there are a number of waysy can participate, including: reading at mass , leading the prayers of the faithful or bringing up the gifts of bread and wine . this can be especially meaningful at month’s mind or anniversary masses, when family members may wish to take part in remembering and praying for a loved one. we warmly invite you to consider getting involved. it would be wonderful to see more people taking an active part in our weekend masses. if you would like to participate, please contact fr. padraig or any member of the parish pastoral council. losing a loved one is one of life’s most challenging experiences . to help all who know this pain there will be a series of 4 tuesday evening talks on ‘how best to cope after a bereavement’ held in the newman centre, ballina on november 3rd, 10th, 17th and 24th from 8-10pm . the course will be presented by monica morley, bereavement counsellor at knock shrine. places are limited and can be booked on

studio to stall with erris workability: studio to stall is a wonderful initiative with erris workability, supporting people to develop their creativity, skills and confidence. participants turn their ideas and creations from the studio into finished products, learning along the way about teamwork, communication, presentation and selling. the journey from studio to stall provides a valuable opportunity to share their talents with the wider community. the programme takes place in both ballina and belmullet, offering a welcoming space to get creative, learn new skills and connect with others. eligibility criteria apply. if you would like to take part, contact siobhan on
